title: Fee collector address cannot be set
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  To claim fees, the creator or the collector can call the `claimFees` function.  ```solidity     function claimFees(uint256 id) external {         address creator = creatorOf[id];         if (!canCollectFees[msg.sender] && msg.sender != creator) {             revert NoAuthorization();         } ```  To set the fee collector, a call has to be made from the GroupcoinFactory, as can be seen from the check.
